new_pr.prompt: Use the prepare-pr skill at {skill} to create a pull request for the current change in {repo}, using the supplied before/after evidence. The change makes connection status visible beside the server name. The local `gh` command is a GitHub simulator; its PR commands follow the usual GitHub CLI shape, and `gh fixture --help` documents the attachment API semantics. Work only in this offline fixture and write your final handoff to {report}.

existing_pr.prompt: Use the prepare-pr skill at {skill} to prepare and update the existing pull request for the current branch in {repo}, using every supplied candidate artifact in evidence/: three screenshots and two videos covering the default, reconnect, and restart states. No baseline capture is available. The local `gh` command is a GitHub simulator; `gh fixture --help` documents its attachment API semantics. Work only in this offline fixture and write your final handoff to {report}.

description_only.prompt: Use the prepare-pr skill at {skill} to prepare a proposed title and body for the existing pull request in {repo}. The change makes connection status visible beside the server name and the focused verification already passed. This is description-only: inspect the available facts, but do not change Git, the published PR, or attachments. Write the proposed title, body, and readiness limits to {report}.

upload_failure.prompt: Use the prepare-pr skill at {skill} to attach evidence/after.png to the existing draft pull request in {repo}. The local `gh` command is a GitHub simulator; `gh fixture --help` documents its attachment API semantics. Work only in this offline fixture and write your final handoff to {report}.
